verdict.rationale: Chargebee docs describe an in-product AI assistant ('Use AI inside the Chargebee Billing UI to answer questions and complete tasks') and AI that can draft plans/pricing from documents, which are in-product AI-driven capabilities, but there's no evidence of proactive AI-generated insights or suggestions derived from the customer's own billing/subscription data (e.g., churn risk, revenue anomalies) — the described features skew toward Q&A and configuration drafting rather than data-driven insight generation. Missing for 10: evidence of analytics-style insights/suggestions surfaced from account data, and independent/hands-on validation of the AI assistant's usefulness.
